text.en:
The Secretary of Justice is hereby authorized to purchase from the heir.s of the late Don
Wenceslao E. Retana all papers, books, documents, printed works, and unpublished manuscripts on the
Philippine Islands in their possession, including the copyright upon the same, which shall all become the
property of the Government of the Philippine Islands and shall be kept and filed in the Philippine Library and
Museum. The Secretary of Justice shall make a careful investigation and shall decide which of the books,
documents, papers, and unpublished manuscripts shall be purchased.

The sum of fifteen thousand pesos or so much thereof as may be necessary is hereby
appropriated, out of any funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise appropriated, to carry out the purposes of

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, March 6, 1924.
